function pathfind(from,to){const start=cellAt(...from),goal=cellAt(...to);if(blocked(...goal))return [];const key=p=>p.join(',');const queue=[start],parents=new Map([[key(start),null]]);for(let i=0;i<queue.length;i++){const p=queue[i];if(key(p)===key(goal)){const out=[];let c=p;while(parents.get(key(c))!==null){out.push([c[0]*CELL+20,c[1]*CELL+20]);c=parents.get(key(c));}return out.reverse();}for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const n=[p[0]+dx,p[1]+dy];if(n[0]<0||n[1]<0||n[0]>=COLS||n[1]>=ROWS||blocked(...n)||parents.has(key(n)))continue;parents.set(key(n),p);queue.push(n);}}return [];}

// Native GDevelop workshop: no embedded web view or runtime dependencies.

function nativePipFit(slot,id){s.pip=attachPip(s.pip,slot,id);const part=slot==='color'?pipPalette.find(p=>p.id===id):pipGroups.find(g=>g.id===slot).parts.find(p=>p.id===id);nativePipWorkshop(s.pipTab,s.pipPage);text('WorkshopNote','Fitted: '+part.name+'. '+(part.note||'My buddy has a new color.'));say('PIP fitted: '+part.name);}

function nativePipWorkshop(tab='travel',page=0){s.pipTab=tab;s.pipPage=page;open('PIP Workshop','Tap a part. Or drag it onto PIP.','');obj('CardBody').hide();obj('CardVisual').hide();for(const n of ['PipBlueprint','PipBlueprintLabel','WorkshopNote',...['travel','trim','body','eyes','tool'].map(n=>'Workshop'+n)])obj(n).hide(false);text('WorkshopNote','Tap to attach. Dragging is optional. PIP is always safe.');

const actions=[['Standard',()=>{s.pip=standardPip();nativePipWorkshop();text('WorkshopNote','Standard PIP restored.')}],['Match crew',()=>{s.pip=matchPipCrew(s.pip,s.crew);nativePipWorkshop(tab,page);text('WorkshopNote','PIP matches my astronaut suit.')}],['Analyze',nativePipSamples],tab==='color'?['More colors',()=>nativePipWorkshop('color',page?0:1)]:['Help',pip],['Explore',()=>{close();say('PIP is ready to explore with me.')}]];
function nativePipSamples(){const found=materials.filter(m=>s.found.has(m.id));open('Ask PIP',found.length?'Choose a sample I discovered.':'Dig to find our first sample.','',[

function nativePipAnalysis(id){const a=pipAnalysis(id,s.pip.tool);if(!a)return;open('PIP: '+a.title,a.detail,'',[]);obj('ScienceModel').hide(false);obj('ScienceModel').setAnimation(materials.findIndex(m=>m.id===id));obj('WorkshopNote').hide(false);text('WorkshopNote',a.note.replace(/(.{1,88})(?:\s|$)/g,'$1\n').trim());obj('WorkshopNote').setPosition(125,380);const options=[['Listen',()=>listenJournal(a.detail+' '+a.note)],['My samples',nativePipSamples],['Workshop',()=>nativePipWorkshop()]];options.forEach(([label,fn],i)=>{obj('PipAction'+i).hide(false);obj('PipActionLabel'+i).hide(false);text('PipActionLabel'+i,label);s.buttons.push({name:'PipAction'+i,fn});});say('PIP uses our science guide. '+a.formula);}
// Runs once per frame as a native GDevelop JavaScript event.

function open(title,body,visual,options=[]){s.overlay=title;s.buttons=[];obj('WorkshopNote').setPosition(125,435);for(const n of ui)obj(n).hide();for(const n of ['Panel','CardTitle','CardBody','CardVisual','Close','CloseLabel'])obj(n).hide(false);text('CardTitle',title);text('CardBody',body.replace(/(.{1,64})(?:\s|$)/g,'$1\n').trim());text('CardVisual',visual);options.slice(0,6).forEach(([label,fn],i)=>{obj('Option'+i).hide(false);obj('OptionLabel'+i).hide(false);text('OptionLabel'+i,label);s.buttons.push({name:'Option'+i,fn})});say(title+'. '+body);}

function arrive(o){s.last=o.id;if(o.kind!=='dig')s.visited.add(o.id);if(o.kind==='home'){say('Back at the start. Choose a picture.');return}if(o.kind==='dig'){s.action=s.settings.reduced?.2:1.2;say('Digging through the soil...');return}s.found.add(o.id);card(o)}

function crewMenu(){open('J.A.C.C. Crew','Tap an astronaut. Everyone can explore every activity.','');for(let i=0;i<roster.length;i++){const r=roster[i];for(const name of ['CrewCard','CrewPortrait','CrewName','CrewDetail'])obj(name+i).hide(false);text('CrewName'+i,(s.crew===i?'[Selected] ':'')+r[0]);text('CrewDetail'+i,(r[1]+' suit | '+r[2]).replace(/(.{1,29})(?:\s|$)/g,'$1\n').trim());s.buttons.push({name:'CrewCard'+i,fn:()=>{s.crew=i;actor.setAnimation(i);text('ActiveCrew',r[0]+' | '+r[1]+' | '+r[2]);close();say(r[0]+' selected. '+r[2])}});}}

['Show places',()=>{close();s.settings.effects=true;objects.forEach(o=>obj('Target_'+o.id).setOpacity(190));say('The cream pictures are places to explore.')}],
['Repeat guidance',()=>say('Tap a picture to explore. Tap the pickaxe to dig. Nothing needs holding or dragging.')],
function journal(){open('My Journal','My stories. My discoveries. My adventures.','',[
['Listen',()=>listenJournal('My journal. Choose what I did, what I discovered, my adventures, my experiments, or my minerals.')]
function settings(){const v=s.settings;open('Settings','All activities wait for you. No scores or penalties.','TAKE YOUR TIME',[
if(!s.initialized){s.initialized=true;close();say('Tap a picture or the ground to explore. PIP can help.');gdjs.evtTools.input.touchSimulateMouse(runtimeScene,true);}

if(s.pipDrag){if(held&&Math.hypot(x-s.pipDrag.x,y-s.pipDrag.y)>12)s.pipDrag.active=true;if(s.pipDrag.active&&held){obj('PipGhost').hide(false);obj('PipGhost').setPosition(x-30,y-30);}if(released){const d=s.pipDrag;s.pipDrag=null;obj('PipGhost').hide();if(d.active){dropped=true;if(x>=115&&x<=455&&y>=180&&y<=440)nativePipFit(s.pipTab,s.pipParts[d.index].id);else text('WorkshopNote','Part put back. Tap it any time to attach it.');}}else if(!held){s.pipDrag=null;obj('PipGhost').hide();}}

if(hit)hit.fn();else if(!s.overlay&&!s.paused&&y>95){s.started=true;s.pending=null;s.action=0;s.path=pathfind([actor.getX()+20,actor.getY()+45],[x,y]);obj('Marker').setPosition(x-12,y-12);obj('Marker').hide(!s.settings.effects);say(s.path.length?'Walking to your marker.':'Choose the path around the pond.');}
